summary: An **FX** request-for-quote desk that prices its own quotes in EUR/USD, GBP/USD and USD/JPY and books a hit at the price it quoted, refusing stale, spent and unknown quotes by name. For the fixed-income conventions — CUSIPs, coupons, price and yield — open the Fixed Income RFQ venue instead. Two clients, a load-ready client, templates, two scenarios that run green, and a three-phase load set.
